title: fix(objectql): a package registered again stops serving an object extension its new manifest dropped
body:
Fixes #35609

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:开发者在本地开发热重载时删掉扩展包给别人对象加字段的声明、或升级/重装一个不再加这些字段的扩展包后,这些字段会立刻从对象上消失,不再需要重启。
- 为什么做:修复「扩展包升级后旧字段还挂在对象上」的数据配置错误,替做扩展包升级和本地开发热重载的构建者解决。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是某个包重新注册时误撤了它仍声明的扩展字段,字段在界面和接口上暂时消失;已存数据不受影响,回滚此改动或重启即可恢复。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

`SchemaRegistry.replacingPackageBody` (the wrapper around every `ObjectQL.registerApp` body registration, which since #33050 withdraws the items a new body no longer ships) now does the same for object extensions:

- Before the body registers, it notes the package's current `extend` layer of each object. After it registers, a layer that is a new contributor is one this body wrote (the extend splice always replaces the package's layer with a new contributor).
- The layers the previous body wrote, for objects the new body no longer extends, are withdrawn through `withdrawObjectExtension`, the existing per-object withdrawal the `object_extension` item delete uses (uninstall's package-wide walk is not reused: it also removes owned objects). Only the very layer the previous body wrote is withdrawn, so a layer another door registered under the package id since (the `object_extension` item door) is kept.
- `withdrawObjectExtension` now records the object's layers in an open registration run before it removes one (`noteObjectEntry`), so a refusal later in the run (a later artifact member, the run-end follow door) puts the extension back. Outside a run this is a no-op, so the item-delete caller is unchanged.
- The record (`packageBodyExtensions`) is put back on refusal and forgotten by `uninstallPackage`, beside `packageBodyItems`.

Everything an extension contributes rides on its one contributor layer (fields, `fieldPatches`, label texts, validations, indexes), so all of it leaves together. Stored data is untouched: the column keeps its values and schema sync drops nothing; the field is no longer served.

## Measure first (the card's steps), on main `c30ce97cd7`

| Path | Re-registers without uninstalling? | Dropped extension's field still served on main? | What said anything |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Bare `registerApp` (card repro) | yes | yes: field, validation and index all served, `com.t.mod:extend` layer kept | nothing |
| `os dev` reload: `metadata:reloaded` → `ObjectQLPlugin.refreshReloadedPackages` → `registerApp` | yes (refresh, never uninstall) | yes | nothing: no warn, schema sync adds only |
| `os dev` reload, full standalone composition (`createStandaloneStack`, the artifact door's `_reloadAndAnnounce`) | yes | NOT MEASURED on this composition (the shared verify lock did not reach the probe this turn); it reaches the same `metadata:reloaded` hook measured in the row above | nothing |
| install-local upgrade 1.0.0 → 1.0.1 dropping the extension (`manifest.register`, no uninstall) | yes | yes: `crm_line` served and `find` returned `cb_account` | the dry run's plan DID say so: `plan.fields.removed` names `crm_line.cb_account`, `environment.columns` `reasons: ['removed'], rows: 1`; removed fields need no confirmation (`schemaUpgradeVerdict`: reported, refused by nothing), so the upgrade answered 200 and then kept serving the field the plan said was removed |
| install-local re-install of the same id and version without the extension | yes | yes | nothing |

Stored column, both before and after the fix: `crm_line.cb_account` keeps its column and its value `ACME` (schema sync drops no column).

After the fix every row above reads "no": the object serves `name` only, `find` no longer returns `cb_account`, the column still holds `ACME`, and the dry run's plan is unchanged (it already named the field as removed; now the runtime agrees with it).

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/reregister-extension-withdraw-35609.test.ts` (new): re-register without the extension (fields, validation and index gone, owner kept); CONTROL rename; another package's extension of the same target untouched; same body again keeps it; an extension registered under the id outside a body kept; a refusal later in the run puts it back (and the record with it); the reload door drops it, CONTROL reload keeps it.
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-reregister-extension-withdraw-35609.test.ts` (new): real kernel, SQL driver, real schema sync, the install-local door: upgrade dropping the extension (plan names the field, object no longer serves it, column keeps its value), same-version re-install, CONTROL upgrade keeping it.

<details><summary>Readings (ablation: the four fixed objectql files put back to main, then restored byte-identical to HEAD)</summary>

One locked run, `unfixed-vs-fixed` legs over the same two commands. The objectql and cloud-connection suites both resolve `@objectstack/objectql` to `packages/objectql/src` (stack frames read `../objectql/src/...`), so no dist rebuild was involved; the on-disk proof is the marker count (`packageBodyExtensions` in `registry-items.ts`: 0 in the unfixed leg, 9 in the fixed leg) and the restore was proven by an empty `git diff HEAD` and matching `git hash-object` = `HEAD:path` for each file.

- UNFIXED (main's four files): `reregister-extension-withdraw-35609.test.ts` 5 failed / 3 passed (the controls pass), `package-refused-upgrade-keeps-installed` and `manifest-service-artifact-refusal-restores` green: `Tests 5 failed | 76 passed (81)`. Install-local readings: `served after upgrade [ 'cb_account', 'name' ]`, `find` returns `"cb_account":"ACME"`, re-install without the extension `[ 'cb_account', 'name' ]`.
- FIXED (HEAD): `Test Files 3 passed (3) · Tests 81 passed (81)`; install-local `served after upgrade [ 'name' ]`, `find` row has no `cb_account`, `column after upgrade {"hasColumn":true,"values":["ACME"]}`, re-install without the extension `[ 'name' ]`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` at the fix (objectql src as on head `555ef3e2c7`): `Test Files 627 passed (627) · Tests 14240 passed (14240)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, then `check:test-typecheck: OK`, debt held).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Clause-②: no. Nothing is refused: a body registered again is never refused over an extension it drops; the dropped layer is withdrawn.
- Owned objects a re-registered body no longer ships are still kept until a restart; `ingestReloadedObjects`' docblock calls that deliberate ("same lifecycle as their tables"). Not touched here.
- `ObjectQLPlugin.refreshReloadedPackages`' docblock still says items removed from the artifact stay registered until restart; that has been out of date since the item withdrawal landed and is now out of date for extensions too. Not edited (outside this card's file surface). Carried by #36328.
- Inferred, not exercised: a withdrawal (this one, an uninstall, an `object_extension` item delete) is not asked the run-end record-currency follow door, which judges registered layers only. A withdrawn extension carrying a currency code field another package's amount follows would leave that pair unjudged until the follower re-registers. Same gap for the two existing withdrawal doors; not filed. Carried by #36328.
- Inferred edge: if a withdrawn layer was the object's last contributor (an extension with no owner, already an ADR-0029 violation), the entry is closed and a refusal later in the run restores the contributor list without reopening the entry. Unreachable through a valid registration.
- Serial constraint: `overlap-check` against #36236 (shares `registry.ts`) merges cleanly; `registry-object-registration.ts` is not touched.
- Prior rulings: `check-prior-rulings --card 35609` over the four files read; no conflict. The closest precedents are the item withdrawal this extends (same wrapper, same restore discipline), ADR-0144 D2/D6 (the run-end follow door, unchanged), ruling A on #35228 (one extension per target per package, unchanged) and ruling 6624345766 (facade form: `registry.ts` gains only a state field, docblocks and host wiring; `check:facade-delegation-only` green).

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates at 555ef3e2c7</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 73 commands derived; all run. 70 exit 0. `check:query-options-erasure` went red (test surface 236 to 237) on a cast in the new cloud-connection pin; fixed in `555ef3e2c7` and re-run green (236). `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no full `dist/`, and the closure build never got the shared lock): NOT MEASURED locally, CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` carries both.
- Re-run on the final head after the last edit: `cross-package-test-inputs`, `test-source-alias`, `nul-bytes`, `refd-timer-probe`, `tier-file-adoption`, `issue-citations`, `doc-authoring`, `facade-delegation-only`: all exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 73 derived, 73 run, 0 unrun.
- `overlap-check --branch=HEAD`: clean against origin/main and #36236.
- Not run locally, declared to CI: `test:repo`, the full cloud-connection suite (only the new file was run), and the Build Core / Type Check workspace lanes.
- Dogfood battery: not owed (no `!`, no narrowing arm).

</details>

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/reregister-extension-withdraw-35609.test.ts` prints 8 passed; revert `registry-items.ts` to `origin/main` and the same command prints 5 failed.

Read first, by risk: `packages/objectql/src/registry-items.ts` (`replacingPackageBody`, the identity test that decides which layers the body wrote), `packages/objectql/src/registry-platform-global.ts` (`withdrawObjectExtension` now notes the run), `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` (host wiring and the record).
